summary:
I wrote src/main.ts from the cheat-sheet forest skeleton and instancing blocks. Typecheck passes. I haven't run `vite build` or loaded the scene in a browser, so the render is unchecked.

The scene has a 260×260 ground plane and 10,000 instanced objects: 8,000 trunks, 8,000 canopies and 2,000 rocks. Each tree is one trunk plus one canopy. Placement comes from a seeded LCG (seed 12345), so the forest is the same on every load. Canopy colours vary in hue and lightness, and rock colours vary in lightness. A shadow-casting directional light, a hemisphere light and exponential fog light the scene. An orbit camera with `autoRotate` circles the 75-unit-radius forest from a high angle. After `app.ready()` the code sets `window.__EVAL_READY__ = true`. The engine's own loop does the rendering.

I did not write my own `requestAnimationFrame` call, on the assumption that the engine's loop satisfies the rendering contract.
